content.stem: 为什么在姓名筛查系统中使用多个制裁名单（如联合国、美国外国资产控制办公室（OFAC）和欧盟名单）很重要？

options.A: 为避免与支付相关的制裁违规行为
options.B: 为避免重新接纳因真实匹配而退出的客户
options.C: 为满足国际监管要求并识别跨司法管辖区的风险
options.D: 与风险偏好声明保持一致

content.stem_en: Why is it important to use multiple sanctions lists, such as United Nations (UN), Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC), and European Union (EU) lists, in name screening systems?

options_en.A: To avoid sanctions breaches related to payments
options_en.B: To avoid onboarding customers previously exited due to a true match
options_en.C: To meet international regulatory requirements and identify risks across jurisdictions
options_en.D: To be in line with the risk appetite statement
